headlines.title: 港交所旗下衍生产品结算所将于11月起接纳中国国债、政策性金融债及财政部债券作为非现金抵押品
headlines.summary: 香港交易及结算所有限公司（香港交易所）今天（星期五）宣布，旗下全资附属公司及场内衍生产品结算所香港期货结算有限公司（期货结算公司）及香港联合交易所期权结算所有限公司（联交所期权结算所），将由2026年11月起接纳透过债券通「北向通」持有的中国国债及及政策性金融债（统称债券通债券），以及中华人民共和国财政部发行的境外发售的债券（财政部债券），作为合资格非现金抵押品，以履行保证金要求，惟须待监管机构批准。

headlines.title_en: HKEX's derivatives clearing house will accept Chinese government bonds, policy financial bonds, and Ministry of Finance bonds as non-cash collateral starting from November
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) announced today (Friday) that its wholly-owned subsidiaries and over-the-counter derivatives clearing houses, HKFE Clearing Corporation Limited (HKCC) and The SEHK Options Clearing House Limited (SEOCH), will, from November 2026, accept Chinese government bonds and policy financial bonds held through Bond Connect "Northbound Trading" (collectively, Bond Connect Bonds), as well as offshore bonds issued by the Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China (MOF Bonds), as eligible non-cash collateral to meet margin requirements, subject to regulatory approval.

headlines.summary: 因涉嫌违反账户实名制等规定，被立案近两个月后，国盛证券与湘财证券同日收到监管下发的行政处罚及行政监管措施事先告知书，拟暂停两家券商新开证券账户3个月。9月24日，国盛证券公告称，公司及相关当事人收到江西证监局下发的《行政处罚事先告知书》《行政监管措施事先告知书》。同日，湘财股份公告称，子公司湘财证券收到湖南证监局下发的《行政处罚事先告知书》和相关行政监管措施事先告知书。两家券商均于7月31日被中国证监会立案。（澎湃）

headlines.title_en: Penalties issued after Guosheng Securities and Xiangcai Securities were investigated: new account openings suspended for 3 months, multiple responsible persons held accountable
headlines.summary_en: After nearly two months of being under investigation for suspected violations of regulations including the real-name account system, Guosheng Securities and Xiangcai Securities received prior notification letters from regulators on the same day regarding administrative penalties and administrative regulatory measures, with plans to suspend the opening of new securities accounts at both brokerages for three months. On September 24, Guosheng Securities announced that the company and relevant parties received the "Prior Notice of Administrative Penalty" and "Prior Notice of Administrative Regulatory Measures" issued by the Jiangxi Regulatory Bureau of the CSRC. On the same day, Xiangcai Co. announced that its subsidiary Xiangcai Securities received the "Prior Notice of Administrative Penalty" and related prior notice of administrative regulatory measures issued by the Hunan Regulatory Bureau of the CSRC. Both brokerages were placed under investigation by the CSRC on July 31. (The Paper)

headlines.summary_en: On September 24, Xiamen welcomed its first land auction after the "8·28" real estate policy, with both residential plots sold at the reserve price, for a total transaction amount of 4.195 billion yuan. Among them, the Huli District plot is the first residential plot in Xiamen and the first in Fujian Province to explicitly implement sales of completed homes after the new policy, with a composite floor price of 58,148 yuan per square meter, setting a new high for residential plot floor prices in Xiamen. In the end, C&D acquired the plot at the reserve price of 3.561 billion yuan. (Securities Times)

headlines.title_en: Egyptian official: Looking forward to deepening economic, trade and investment cooperation with China
headlines.summary_en: Egyptian Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade Mohamed Farid Saleh said at a press conference held in Cairo on the 24th that Egypt welcomes Chinese enterprises to invest in Egypt and looks forward to further expanding cooperation between the two sides in areas such as seawater desalination, artificial intelligence and digital services. Saleh spoke highly of the performance of Chinese enterprises in Egypt. He said Chinese enterprises have entered some industrial sectors not yet covered in Egypt and have made positive contributions to the country's industrial development. (Xinhua News Agency)
